AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
Billi is a personal budgeting and expense tracker that keeps the user's money records on the phone. Its functions record an expense or income, report account balances and spending for a period, report monthly budgets, and list recent transactions.
Operational patterns: - getSpendingSummary returns the user's account names. Use one of those names as the account in addTransaction when the user names an account loosely. - To answer how much was spent at one merchant, call getRecentTransactions with that merchant as the query and add up the amounts. - getSpendingSummary with a category answers spending questions for one category in a single call.
Constraints: - Amounts are in the user's currency, returned in each response as a symbol such as ₹. - Dates are calendar days in the phone's time zone. - Every function fails with a denied error while the user has turned off Gemini and assistants under More, Privacy and security.
